description: List payments, newest first (50 per page by default) — product, price, discount, tax, coupon, affiliate, gateway and billing info. All filters are ANDed. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/payments.

affiliate_id.description: Only payments referred by this affiliate (id or email).

created_after.description: Created after (Unix timestamp in seconds, e.g. 1626088013).

created_before.description: Created before (Unix timestamp in seconds, e.g. 1626088013).

product_id.description: Only payments for this product id.

user_id.description: Only payments by this user (id or email).

name: learnworlds_list_payments
title: List payments
